visual.name: bfusionSunkCostDecisionBoard
visual.description: Quadrant decision board: every project plotted by Budget Consumed (X) vs Project Health / Value Confidence (Y). Splits the portfolio into Healthy Delivery Zone, Failing Early (Pause & Re-plan) and Sunk Cost Trap (Terminate). Right-side Recommended Action card surfaces the worst offender, the recoverable budget freed by killing it, and smart-insight callouts. What-if sliders move the budget / health cut-offs in real time.

dataRoles.name: project
dataRoles.description: One bubble per value (project, plan, or program). Supports drill-down (e.g. Portfolio > Program > Project).

dataRoles.name: category
dataRoles.description: Optional grouping used for bubble color (e.g. Business Unit, Plan Type).

dataRoles.name: budgetConsumed
dataRoles.description: X-axis. Spent / Budget as a ratio (0..1+). Bind [SunkCost | Budget Consumed %].

dataRoles.name: healthScore
dataRoles.description: Y-axis. Project health on a 0..1 scale. 0 = failing, 1 = on track. Bind [SunkCost | Value Confidence Score].

dataRoles.name: recoverable
dataRoles.description: Bubble area driver — recoverable budget if terminated now. Falls back to a uniform size if not bound.

dataRoles.name: budget
dataRoles.description: Optional. Total budget. Used in tooltips, KPI tiles, and the Recommended Action narrative.

dataRoles.name: consumed
dataRoles.description: Optional. Sunk cost — amount already spent. Used in tooltips and the Recommended Action narrative.

dataRoles.name: budgetConsumedPrev
dataRoles.description: Optional. Prior-period Budget Consumed %. When bound with Health (prior) the visual draws a trajectory arrow from old → new position.

dataRoles.name: healthPrev
dataRoles.description: Optional. Prior-period Value Confidence / Health score. See Budget Consumed (prior).

dataRoles.name: tooltipFields
dataRoles.description: Extra measures to show in tooltips.

dataRoles.name: drillthrough
dataRoles.description: Fields carried when the user drills through to another page.

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model.

budgetThreshold.description: Vertical cut-off on the budget axis. Default 0.50 — projects right of this line and below the health line are Sunk Cost Trap candidates.

healthThreshold.description: Horizontal cut-off on the health axis. Default 0.50 — projects below this line are failing. Above = Healthy Delivery Zone.

minRecoverable.description: Recommended Action card hides when recoverable budget is below this. 0 = always show.

topNCandidates.description: How many candidates to list in the panel. Default 3.

licenseKey.description: Paste your BFusion license key here. Contact info@bfusion.eu for a license.
